$comment: Whisperio release manifest - ANDROID ONLY (platforms.android). iOS is managed elsewhere (mobile/, docs/launch/); no iOS manifest exists in this repo, so none is duplicated here. Run: node ~/.claude/skills/release-readiness/tools/check.mjs . --platform android [--offline] [--last-build N]. Paths are relative to the repo root.
notes: ACCEPTED EXCEPTION - cleartext (CONTRACT 4.3): android/app/src/main/res/xml/network_security_config.xml sets base-config cleartextTrafficPermitted="true" ONLY because a network security config cannot express CIDR ranges and a user-configured self-hosted server often lives at a private IP (192.168.x.x, 10.x.x.x, *.local). The real guard is in :core (android/core/src/main/kotlin/ai/whisperio/core/HttpClients.kt): every official provider uses secureClient (TLS only, no CLEARTEXT connection spec); only a URL that passed BaseUrlPolicy gets localClient (followRedirects=false, network interceptor re-validating every hop), so plain http can never reach a public host. The release-readiness check play-cleartext flags this file by design; it is the one accepted FAIL/WARN and must be justified, not removed.

NOT APPLICABLE - account deletion: Whisperio has no account, no server and no sign-in, so there is no in-app account-deletion path and no Play 'Delete account URL'. Local data is removed by Settings > Erase all data (AppGraph.eraseAllData). The account-deletion / account-deletion-web checks are expected to be reported as not applicable (the gate has no N/A switch yet).
FREE app: no IAP, no Play Billing, no ads, no subscriptions - ever (CONTRACT, top). platforms.android.iap is omitted on purpose.
Reviewer key: demoAccount.envVars holds the NAME of the env var that carries a low-limit reviewer API key. The value goes only into Play Console > App content > App access, never into the repo.

play.$comment: Google Play target API requirement (new apps + updates). UPDATE YEARLY after the Aug 31 deadline announcement.

cleartextException.reason: NSC cannot express CIDR ranges for user-configured LAN/self-hosted servers; the real guard is :core HttpClients - secureClient is TLS-only for every official provider, localClient only for BaseUrlPolicy-approved private hosts with redirects off and per-hop re-validation (CONTRACT 4.3).

accountDeletion.notApplicable: Whisperio has no account and no server: users bring their own provider API key; local data is removed with in-app "Erase all data" or uninstall (CONTRACT 8.1).
